hostRequirement: Local Gentoo Linux graphical session with KWin/Xwayland
actions: Launch the actual process with the authored BMP and verify visible metadata.
Send a real wheel event, record requested and Avalonia-reported pointer positions, and verify image-space anchor preservation.
Drag the pointer within the player window and verify the reported pan delta.
Activate Fit through reported control bounds and sample known red, blue and asymmetric diagonal pixels from a window screenshot.
Resize the actual Xwayland application window and verify viewport changes without image aspect distortion.
Use the actual storage provider to open PNG after zoom, pan, Fit and resize; verify new image metadata and reset zoom/pan.
Launch a second actual app process on the alpha candidate fixture and sample transparent and partially transparent compositing.
limits: The screenshot comparison is fixture-scoped rendering evidence, not cross-renderer screenshot parity.
The reported Avalonia pointer location is used for zoom-anchor math because Xwayland and Wayland scaling changed the observed location in runs.
Windows GUI and hosted CI are not part of this local scenario.
